<b>Heavy Rosary Necklaces</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{R|220}}.

Strung Rosaries are not dropped upon death.

== How to Acquire ==
Heavy Rosary Necklaces can be found by interacting with glowing spots across [[Pharloom]], and as a reward for completing [[Wishes]].
